one_pass.why: A states GT study compared female pronoun frequency with BLS female participation (fact_a), and the adaptation study built a gender-balanced set of 194 professions/388 sentences (fact_b), and contrasts external demographic comparison vs balanced training data (synthesis). Citations to both papers' passages support these claims.

paper_read.why: B describes GT method (gender-neutral language sentences, pronoun frequency, BLS comparison showing underestimation) and the domain-adaptation handcrafted set (194 professions, 388 sentences, template, no-overlap variant). Both facts and the synthesis (external demographic comparison vs balanced training set) are present and correctly attributed, with valid citations to both papers.
